stem: 一家金融机构正在进行全企业范围的风险评估（EWRA），发现其私人银行部门存在较高的固有洗钱风险，原因是客户资产净值高且财务结构复杂。不过，该机构已实施严格的客户尽职调查（CDD）和强化尽职调查（EDD）程序，并配备先进的交易监控系统。这些控制措施会如何影响剩余风险的评估？

options.A: 由于现有控制措施的有效性，剩余风险将显著降低。
options.B: 剩余风险会适度降低，但可能仍需进一步采取控制措施才能达到可接受的水平。
options.C: 由于私人银行业务的固有性质，剩余风险仍将居高不下。
options.D: 剩余风险将被完全消除，因为这些控制措施会降低所有潜在风险。

risk_flags.note: 中文答案=A，英文答案=B；两边似乎表达不同残余风险程度。未改答案，保留风险提示。

stem_en: A financial institution is conducting an enterprise-wide risk assessment (EWRA) and has identified a high inherent risk of money laundering associated with its private banking division due to the clientele's high net worth and complex financial structures. However, the institution has implemented robust customer due diligence (CDD) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) procedures, along with sophisticated transaction monitoring systems. How would these controls impact the assessment of residual risk?

options_en.A: The residual risk would be significantly reduced due to the effectiveness of the controls in place
options_en.B: The residual risk would be moderately reduced, but further controls may be necessary to achieve an acceptable level
options_en.C: The residual risk would remain high due to the inherent nature of private banking
options_en.D: The residual risk would be completely eliminated because these controls reduce all potential risks
